paper_title: Overview of the Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment (CASPEr)

notes: Overview/proposal paper for CASPEr Electric (axion-gluon/EDM coupling, gd) and CASPEr Wind (ALP-nucleon coupling gaNN). Presents only sensitivity PROJECTIONS shown in Figs. 3 and 4, not measured exclusion limits. No numerical data points are tabulated in the text; the projected reach curves are only shown graphically without extractable numeric values. CASPEr Electric probes the axion-EDM coupling gd (AxionEDM), while CASPEr Wind probes gaNN (AxionNeutron). Local DM density assumed rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3.
